provenance: policy_v1.json (7688b012…) and policy_corrections_v1.1.json (cdbaec66…) remain frozen; this record versions a further pre-activation safety correction without rewriting them.

corrections.description: live and delayed sources are explicit allowlists; any unknown source is a veto, never silently treated as live
atomic due-proposal claiming independently enforces auto mode, VERY_HIGH, allowed action, active experiment, and kill switches
contract multiplier is derived from instrument type (CALL/PUT 100x, SHARE 1x), not a caller default
close/reduce require a pre-registered scenario trigger; unknown/absent triggers fail closed
malformed or non-finite evidence numerics fail closed rather than crashing or passing
